# Camera node, CM4: the firmware configuration inside the signed boot image (boot.img).
arm_64bit=1
kernel=Image
initramfs camnode-initramfs.cpio followkernel
start_file=start4.elf
fixup_file=fixup4.dat
gpu_mem=128
enable_uart=0
disable_splash=1
camera_auto_detect=0
display_auto_detect=0
dtparam=audio=off
dtparam=i2c_arm=on
dtoverlay=disable-bt
dtoverlay=disable-wifi
# The IMX462 runs on the imx290 driver.
dtoverlay=imx290,clock-frequency=74250000
# Reference wiring (ASSUMPTIONS CAM-image-6): the button on GPIO 17 to ground, the IR
# illuminator's driver on GPIO 27.
dtoverlay=gpio-key,gpio=17,active_low=1,gpio_pull=up,keycode=256,label=camnode-button
dtoverlay=gpio-led,gpio=27,label=ir
